mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods WHERE gb_distributer_purchase_goods_id = #{id}

sql.if: AND IFNULL(gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_type, 0) = 1 AND (gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id IS NULL OR gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id = -1)
AND ( IFNULL(gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_type, 0) = 5 OR ( IFNULL(gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_type, 0) = 1 AND gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id != -1 ) )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal AS DECIMAL(24, 6))), 0) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id

SELECT IFNULL(gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_type, 0) AS purchaseType, CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) AS lineCount, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal AS DECIMAL(24, 6))), 0) AS lineSubtotal FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
GROUP BY IFNULL(gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_type, 0)

SELECT CASE WHEN IFNULL(gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_type, 0) = 5 THEN 'supplier_channel' WHEN IFNULL(gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_type, 0) = 1 AND gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id != -1 THEN 'supplier_channel' WHEN IFNULL(gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_type, 0) = 1 THEN 'self_strict' ELSE 'other' END AS methodBucket, CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) AS lineCount, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal AS DECIMAL(24, 6))), 0) AS lineSubtotal, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_quantity AS DECIMAL(24, 6))), 0) AS lineQuantity FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
GROUP BY CASE WHEN IFNULL(gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_type, 0) = 5 THEN 'supplier_channel' WHEN IFNULL(gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_type, 0) = 1 AND gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id != -1 THEN 'supplier_channel' WHEN IFNULL(gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_type, 0) = 1 THEN 'self_strict' ELSE 'other' END

SELECT CASE WHEN agg.name_key <> '' THEN agg.name_key WHEN agg.std_key <> '' THEN agg.std_key ELSE '（未命名商品）' END AS gb_dg_goods_name, agg.times AS gb_dg_quantity_days, agg.gb_distributer_goods_id AS gb_distributer_goods_id FROM ( SELECT TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_name, '')) AS name_key, TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_standardname, '')) AS std_key, CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) AS times, MIN(dg.gb_distributer_goods_id) AS gb_distributer_goods_id FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg INNER JOIN gb_distributer_goods AS dg ON dg.gb_distributer_goods_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal > 0
GROUP BY TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_name, '')), TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_standardname, '')) ) agg ORDER BY agg.times DESC, gb_dg_goods_name ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN agg.name_key <> '' THEN agg.name_key WHEN agg.std_key <> '' THEN agg.std_key ELSE '（未命名商品）' END AS gb_dg_goods_name, CAST(ROUND(agg.total_subtotal, 1) AS CHAR) AS goodsPurTotalSubtotal, agg.gb_distributer_goods_id AS gb_distributer_goods_id FROM ( SELECT TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_name, '')) AS name_key, TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_standardname, '')) AS std_key, SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal AS DECIMAL(24, 6))) AS total_subtotal, MIN(dg.gb_distributer_goods_id) AS gb_distributer_goods_id FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg INNER JOIN gb_distributer_goods AS dg ON dg.gb_distributer_goods_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal > 0
GROUP BY TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_name, '')), TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_standardname, '')) ) agg ORDER BY agg.total_subtotal DESC, gb_dg_goods_name ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN agg.name_key <> '' THEN agg.name_key WHEN agg.std_key <> '' THEN agg.std_key ELSE '（未命名商品）' END AS gb_dg_goods_name, CAST(ROUND(agg.total_quantity, 1) AS CHAR) AS gb_dg_self_price, agg.std_key AS gb_dg_goods_standardname, agg.gb_distributer_goods_id AS gb_distributer_goods_id FROM ( SELECT TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_name, '')) AS name_key, TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_standardname, '')) AS std_key, SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_quantity AS DECIMAL(24, 6))) AS total_quantity, MIN(dg.gb_distributer_goods_id) AS gb_distributer_goods_id FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg INNER JOIN gb_distributer_goods AS dg ON dg.gb_distributer_goods_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal > 0
GROUP BY TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_name, '')), TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_standardname, '')) ) agg WHERE agg.total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY agg.total_quantity DESC, gb_dg_goods_name ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_department_id AS departmentId, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal AS DECIMAL(24, 6))), 0) AS purchaseSubtotal FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_department_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_department_id

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 0) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id

SELECT IFNULL( SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal AS DECIMAL(18, 4))) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_quantity AS DECIMAL(18, 4))), 0), 0) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id

SELECT CAST(ROUND(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 0), 2) AS CHAR) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
AND gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price) != ''

SELECT CAST(ROUND(IFNULL(MIN(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 0), 2) AS CHAR) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
AND gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price) != ''

SELECT CAST(ROUND(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 0), 2) AS CHAR) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id

SELECT CAST(ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 0), 2) AS CHAR) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id

SELECT t.dis_goods_id AS disGoodsId, t.goods_name AS goodsName, t.standard_name AS standardName, CAST(ROUND(t.period_avg_unit_price, 2) AS CHAR) AS currentUnitPrice, CAST(ROUND(t.compare_avg_unit_price, 2) AS CHAR) AS previousUnitPrice, CAST(ROUND( (t.period_avg_unit_price - t.compare_avg_unit_price) / NULLIF(t.compare_avg_unit_price, 0) * 100, 1) AS CHAR) AS priceChangePercent FROM ( SELECT p.dis_goods_id, p.goods_name, p.standard_name, p.period_avg_unit_price, c.compare_avg_unit_price FROM ( SELECT gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id AS dis_goods_id, TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_name, '')) AS goods_name, TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_standardname, '')) AS standard_name, AVG(CAST(TRIM(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price) AS DECIMAL(18, 4))) AS period_avg_unit_price FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_goods dg ON dg.gb_distributer_goods_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id
AND gdpg.gb_DPG_stock_finish_date >= #{startDate} AND gdpg.gb_DPG_stock_finish_date <= #{stopDate} AND gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price) <> ''
GROUP BY gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id, TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_name, '')), TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_standardname, '')) ) p INNER JOIN ( SELECT gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id AS dis_goods_id, AVG(CAST(TRIM(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price) AS DECIMAL(18, 4))) AS compare_avg_unit_price FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
AND gdpg.gb_DPG_stock_finish_date >= #{compareStartDate} AND gdpg.gb_DPG_stock_finish_date <= #{compareStopDate} AND gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price) <> ''
GROUP BY gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id ) c ON p.dis_goods_id = c.dis_goods_id WHERE ABS(p.period_avg_unit_price - c.compare_avg_unit_price) > 0.0001 ) t ORDER BY ABS(t.period_avg_unit_price - t.compare_avg_unit_price) DESC LIMIT #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER}

SELECT t.supplier_id AS supplierId, CASE WHEN njs.nx_jrdhs_supplier_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(njs.nx_jrdhs_supplier_name) <> '' THEN TRIM(njs.nx_jrdhs_supplier_name) ELSE CONCAT('供货商ID ', IFNULL(t.supplier_id, ''), '（名称未维护）') END AS supplierName, ROUND(t.total_purchase_amount, 1) AS totalPurchaseAmount, t.purchase_line_count AS purchaseLineCount FROM ( SELECT gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id AS supplier_id, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal AS DECIMAL(24, 6))), 0) AS total_purchase_amount, COUNT(*) AS purchase_line_count FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
AND gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id > 0
GROUP BY gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id ORDER BY total_purchase_amount DESC LIMIT 10 ) t LEFT JOIN nx_jrdh_supplier AS njs ON njs.nx_jrdh_supplier_id = t.supplier_id

SELECT CAST(t.supplier_id AS SIGNED) AS supplierId, CASE WHEN njs.nx_jrdhs_supplier_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(njs.nx_jrdhs_supplier_name) <> '' THEN TRIM(njs.nx_jrdhs_supplier_name) ELSE CONCAT('供货商ID ', IFNULL(CAST(t.supplier_id AS CHAR), ''), '（名称未维护）') END AS supplierName, t.goods_name AS goodsName, t.standard_name AS standardName, ROUND(t.total_subtotal, 1) AS purchaseAmount, ROUND(t.total_quantity, 3) AS purchaseQuantity, CAST(t.line_count AS SIGNED) AS orderCount, ROUND(IFNULL(t.total_subtotal / NULLIF(t.total_quantity, 0), 0), 4) AS avgUnitPrice FROM ( SELECT gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id AS supplier_id, MAX(TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_name, ''))) AS goods_name, MAX(TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_standardname, ''))) AS standard_name, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal AS DECIMAL(24, 6))), 0) AS total_subtotal, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_quantity AS DECIMAL(24, 6))), 0) AS total_quantity, CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) AS line_count FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg INNER JOIN gb_distributer_goods AS dg ON dg.gb_distributer_goods_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal > 0 AND gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id > 0
GROUP BY gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id HAVING SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal AS DECIMAL(24, 6))) > 0 ) t LEFT JOIN nx_jrdh_supplier AS njs ON njs.nx_jrdh_supplier_id = t.supplier_id ORDER BY t.total_subtotal DESC

SELECT CAST(t.goods_id AS SIGNED) AS disGoodsId, t.goods_name AS goodsName, t.standard_name AS standardName, ROUND(t.total_subtotal, 1) AS purchaseSubtotal, ROUND(t.total_quantity, 3) AS purchaseQuantity, CAST(t.line_count AS SIGNED) AS orderCount, ROUND(IFNULL(t.total_subtotal / NULLIF(t.total_quantity, 0), 0), 4) AS avgUnitPrice FROM ( SELECT gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id AS goods_id, MAX(TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_name, ''))) AS goods_name, MAX(TRIM(IFNULL(dg.gb_dg_goods_standardname, ''))) AS standard_name, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal AS DECIMAL(24, 6))), 0) AS total_subtotal, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_quantity AS DECIMAL(24, 6))), 0) AS total_quantity, CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) AS line_count FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg INNER JOIN gb_distributer_goods AS dg ON dg.gb_distributer_goods_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal > 0 AND gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND gdpg.gb_DPG_purchase_nx_supplier_id > 0
GROUP BY gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id HAVING SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_subtotal AS DECIMAL(24, 6))) > 0 ) t ORDER BY t.total_subtotal DESC

SELECT gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id AS disGoodsId, IFNULL(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_quantity AS DECIMAL(18,6))), 0) AS buyQtySum FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
GROUP BY gdpg.gb_DPG_dis_goods_id
